Our Story

Born from the mist
of the mountains

Cāya began as a simple belief — that the purest things grow closest to the sky. Nestled in Kalimpong, at the crossroads of Darjeeling's tea country and the Eastern Himalayan foothills, we grow, forage, and craft products that carry the quiet power of the land.

Every leaf, every drop of honey, every botanical we use is traceable to a specific hillside and a specific season. No shortcuts. No additives. Just place, care, and time.

Herbal Tea · Hand Wash · Raw Honey

The Café

A place to
slow down

The Cāya Organic Café is a small, intentional space in Kalimpong where you can taste everything we make. Sit with a cup of fresh herbal tea, watch the mist roll in over the valley, and feel what it means to be unhurried.

We serve seasonal menus built around what's growing — nothing forced, nothing out of place.

  • Seasonal herbal teas brewed to order
  • Raw honey tastings with local bread
  • Curated organic pantry to take home
  • Valley-view seating, open mornings to dusk
